description: NHFLOW semi-implicit non-hydrostatic with wetting-drying and breaking: Synolakis breaking solitary wave (H/d 0.28, 1:19.85 beach), coarse (dx 0.2 m, dt 0.05 s, theta 1/2, A 510 11, A 520 2), A 537 1 (Newton iteration of the wet pattern of the pressure equation), Baquet viscosity in the top layer (A 550 1).
